hint.en: Invokes a user-defined action declared under api: actions: in the device YAML. Arguments are a JSON object keyed by the variable names the action declares, for example {"slot": "homey_t_line1", "value": "Hello"}. Leave empty for an action that takes none.
Writes a Homey-fed text slot on the node. Writes are batched and the screen refreshes once.
Writes a Homey-fed numeric slot on the node. Writes are batched and the screen refreshes once.

title.en: Set a display slot from a sensor

hint.en: Reads a value from another ESPHome device and writes it to a numeric slot, labelling the slot with the unit Homey uses for that capability. Reads on demand, so it also suits readings that rarely change.
Flushes any pending slot writes and redraws the panel. A full ePaper refresh takes a few seconds.
